shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'middleware.*' -g 'proxy.*' -g 'node_modules/next/dist/docs/**' | head -200 && printf '\\nTop-level files:\\n' && ls -la && printf '\\nNext docs candidates:\\n' && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -100"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '\\n%s\\n' '--- app files ---' && rg --files app && printf '\\n%s\\n' '--- middleware docs ---' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '(middleware|proxy)' && printf '\\n%s\\n' '--- root instructions ---' && cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n%s\\n' '--- next version ---' && node -p \"require('next/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/middleware.md && printf '\\n--- proxy file convention ---\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md && printf '\\n--- getting started proxy ---\\n' && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/16-proxy.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- page ---' && cat app/page.tsx && printf '\\n%s\\n' '--- layout ---' && cat app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n%s\\n' '--- next.config.ts ---' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n%s\\n' '--- TypeScript config ---' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n%s\\n' '--- root files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"'"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n -A55 -B8 'Setting Headers|response headers|NextResponse.next|runtime|Response headers' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md | head -260 && printf '\\n--- relevant runtime notes ---\\n' && rg -n -A15 -B5 'runtime|Node.js runtime|Edge Runtime' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md | tail -100"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
+import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log(request.nextUrl.pathname)
+
+  const response = NextResponse.next()
+  response.headers.set('X-Request-Id', randomUUID())
+
+  return response
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npx tsc --noEmit"
/bin/bash -c 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- proxy.ts'

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
*** End Patch
PATCH

git diff --check && git status --short"
